title: Publish firstmate explainer page to GitHub Pages via xtask and workflow
summary: Render one self-contained HTML explainer from studies/firstmate-work-handling via a new Rust xtask `site` command, and add .github/workflows/pages.yml (a governance file, listed and named explicitly) that builds and deploys it to GitHub Pages. Enabling Pages in repo settings and verifying a live HTTP 200 are owner actions outside the change.

defaults_applied.how: Renderer is an xtask Rust command.
New renderer tests; cargo test and clippy clean.
Page cites claim ids and the pinned commit.
Governance file listed and named in a criterion.
No secrets in workflow or page.
README, changelog and design note written for outsiders.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The live URL (HTTP 200) cannot be checked by the verifier or produced by a commit alone; it needs the owner to enable Pages with source GitHub Actions and the workflow to run after landing.
The renderer may add a small crate dependency only if needed; plain string building with an escape function is preferred.
studies/firstmate-work-handling JSON files are the sole content source.

acceptance_criteria.text: New file .github/workflows/pages.yml (governance change, named here) runs on push to the default branch and workflow_dispatch, builds with `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, and deploys using actions/configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact and deploy-pages, with minimal permissions (contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write) and a concurrency group.
Existing .github/workflows/ci.yml, athena.toml, defaults.toml, rust-toolchain.toml and Cargo lint tables are unchanged.
An xtask `site` subcommand renders one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, viewport meta, responsive layout, prefers-color-scheme dark mode) with text taken from the study JSON and HTML-escaped.
Every factual statement on the page cites a claim id from claims.json, and the page states the pinned firstmate commit from pin.json.
The output directory is gitignored; the build produces index.html at the site root so the Pages URL serves it.

A design note in docs/design records alternatives and deferrals; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; README gives the local build command and the expected Pages URL, and notes the owner must set Pages source to GitHub Actions.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`; it exits 0 and writes index.html; `git status` shows no tracked changes from the output.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`; all pass, including new renderer tests for escaping, claim-id citation and missing-data error.

out_of_scope: Confirming the live URL returns HTTP 200
Changes to ci.yml, athena.toml, lints or toolchain
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than reference: new renderer, workflow and docs across many files, and a live-URL goal that cannot be verified in-repo.
